📌 FAZL ALI COMMISSION.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ The creation of Andhra state intensified the demand from other  regions for creation of states on linguistic basis. 

🔸️ This forced the Government of India to appoint (in December, 1953) a three- member States Reorganisation Commission under the chairmanship of Fazl Ali to re-examine the whole question. 

🔸️ Its other two members were K.M. Panikkar and H.N. Kunzru. It submitted its report in September 1955 and broadly accepted language as the basis of reorganisation of states. But, it rejected  the theory of ‘one language-one state’. 

🔸️ Its view was that the unity of India should be regarded as the primary consideration in any redrawing of the country’s political units.

📌 J.V.P COMMITTEE.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ Dhar commission report created much resentment and led to the appointment of another Linguistic Provinces Committee by the Congress in December, 1948, itself to examine the whole question afresh. 

🔸️ It consisted of Jawaharlal Nehru, Vallahbhai Patel and Pattabhi Sitaramayya and hence, was popularly known as JVP Committee.

🔸️ It submitted its report in April, 1949, and formally rejected language as the basis for reorganisation of states.

🔸️ However, in October, 1953, the Government of India was forced to create the first linguistic state, known as Andhra state, by separating the Telugu speaking areas from the Madras state. 

🔸️ This followed a prolonged popular agitation and the death of Potti  Sriramulu, a Congress person of standing, after a 56-day hunger strike for the cause.

युगे युगीन भारत संग्रहालय का विकास किस ऐतिहासिक भवन परिसर में किया जाएगा?
Answer: - North and South Block Complex, New Delhi / नॉर्थ और साउथ ब्लॉक परिसर, नई दिल्ली

3 .Which city will host the 19th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas Convention, to be held from 7 to 9 January 2027?
7 से 9 जनवरी 2027 तक आयोजित होने वाले 19वें प्रवासी भारतीय दिवस सम्मेलन की मेजबानी कौन-सा शहर करेगा?
Answer: - Kolkata, West Bengal / कोलकाता, पश्चिम बंगाल

4 .What is the declared theme of the 19th Pravasi Bharatiya Divas Convention?
19वें प्रवासी भारतीय दिवस सम्मेलन की घोषित थीम क्या है?
Answer: - From Roots to Return: Reigniting Diaspora Connect with Bharat / जड़ों से वापसी तक: प्रवासी भारतीयों का भारत से जुड़ाव पुनर्जीवित करना

5 .To what percentage has Moody's Ratings raised India's GDP growth forecast for the financial year 2026–27?
मूडीज रेटिंग्स ने वित्त वर्ष 2026–27 के लिए भारत की GDP वृद्धि दर का अनुमान बढ़ाकर कितने प्रतिशत कर दिया है?
Answer: - 7% / 7 प्रतिशत

6 .According to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) quarterly report for July–September 2026, what was India's overall Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR)?
जुलाई–सितंबर 2026 की आवधिक श्रम बल सर्वेक्षण (PLFS) तिमाही रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, भारत की समग्र श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) कितनी थी?
Answer: - 55.5% / 55.5 प्रतिशत

7 .Which state secured the first rank in the Access Equality Index 2026?
एक्सेस इक्वैलिटी इंडेक्स 2026 में किस राज्य ने प्रथम स्थान प्राप्त किया?
Answer: - Goa / गोवा

8 .Which city secured the first rank in the Clean River Front City category in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26?
स्वच्छ सर्वेक्षण 2025-26 में स्वच्छ रिवर फ्रंट शहर की श्रेणी में प्रथम स्थान किस शहर ने प्राप्त किया?
Answer: - Rewa, Madhya Pradesh / रीवा, मध्य प्रदेश

9 .Which city secured the first rank in the Clean Coastal City category in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26?
स्वच्छ सर्वेक्षण 2025-26 में स्वच्छ तटीय शहर की श्रेणी में प्रथम स्थान किस शहर ने प्राप्त किया?
Answer: - Puri, Odisha / पुरी, ओडिशा

10 .Which city secured the first rank in the category of cities with a population between 50,000 and 3 lakhs in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26?
स्वच्छ सर्वेक्षण 2025-26 में 50 हजार से 3 लाख तक की आबादी वाले शहरों की श्रेणी में प्रथम स्थान किसने प्राप्त किया?
Answer: - Dewas, Madhya Pradesh / देवास, मध्य प्रदेश

11 .Which city secured the first rank in the category of cities with a population between 3 lakhs and 10 lakhs in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26?
स्वच्छ सर्वेक्षण 2025-26 में 3 लाख से 10 लाख तक की आबादी वाले शहरों की श्रेणी में प्रथम स्थान किस शहर ने प्राप्त किया?
Answer: - Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh / उज्जैन, मध्य प्रदेश

12 .Which city secured the first rank in the category of cities with a population of over 10 lakhs in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26?
स्वच्छ सर्वेक्षण 2025-26 में 10 लाख से अधिक आबादी वाले शहरों की श्रेणी में प्रथम स्थान किस शहर ने प्राप्त किया?
Answer: - Visakhapatnam (GVMC), Andhra Pradesh / विशाखापत्तनम (GVMC), आंध्र प्रदेश

📌 INTEGRATION OF PRINCELY STATE.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ At the time of independence, India comprised two categories of political units, namely, the British provinces (under the direct rule of British government) and the princely states (under the rule of native princes but subject to the paramountcy of the British Crown). 

🔸️ The Indian Independence Act (1947) created two independent and separate dominions of India and Pakistan and gave three options to the princely states which are :-

• joining India, joining Pakistan or remaining independent. 

🔸️ Of the 552 princely states situated within the geographical boundaries of India, 549 joined India and the remaining 3 (Hyderabad, Junagarh and Kashmir) refused to join India.

🔸️ However, in course of time, they were also integrated with India–Hyderabad by means of police action, Junagarh by means of referendum and Kashmir by the Instrument of Accession.
